title: E-commerce Store & Admin Dashboard
subtitle: A complete online jewellery store, with orders, payments and returns run from a phone.
_comment_package: RENAMED from 'Starter Store'. That name is a PUBLISHED TIER at ₹99,000 for
8 weeks, declared in the site's structured data, and this engagement is a
deliberately smaller product at a lower price. Two different things cannot
share a name: a client who searches the studio mid-negotiation would find
the same package at 2.5x the price. tools/quote-doc.mjs refuses to render
a quote whose package name collides with a tier, so this cannot regress.
packageNote: A smaller build than our published Starter Store — see the comparison overleaf.
_comment_price: ₹39,999 over 15 working days was ₹2,666/day: 27% of the ₹10,000 day rate
and 33% of the ₹8,000 floor. The renderer prints the implied day rate and
warns when it falls under the floor, so this is visible before the PDF is
sent rather than after the work is done.
Two numbers moved, not one. Price up, AND the timeline out to 5 weeks —
ten page types, an admin dashboard, Razorpay, a returns workflow, nine
message templates, six policy pages, catalogue load, staging review and
training is not fifteen days of work, and a date that slips is worse than

stages.name: Kick-off
stages.what: We collect your product list, photographs, descriptions, WhatsApp number and business details. You get the checklist overleaf; nothing else is needed from you until stage three.

stages.name: Design
stages.what: Home, product and checkout screens for your approval. Two rounds of revisions are included at this stage — this is where changes are cheap.

stages.name: Build
stages.what: Storefront, admin dashboard, database and payment integration. Your catalogue loaded with real photographs, descriptions, prices and stock.

stages.name: Review
stages.what: A private staging link. You place test orders, we fix what you find, and we walk you through the dashboard on a call.

stages.name: Launch
stages.what: Domain pointed, payment keys switched to live, sample data cleared. The shop is open.
